comparison.photo_skipped: A comparison video is only made for videos.
error.analysis.incomplete: Part of this file could not be checked, so it is not exported as clean.
error.analysis.discards: These settings differ from the ones used for {count} of the clips you reviewed. Analyzing again replaces their analysis and discards your decisions and added areas ({decisions} in all).
error.analysis.discards.one: These settings differ from the ones used for the clip you reviewed. Analyzing again replaces its analysis and discards your decisions and added areas ({decisions} in all).
error.analysis.version: This analysis file comes from another version ({version}) and cannot be read.
error.clip.state: That cannot be done with this file right now.
error.clip.state.analyzing: This file is still being analyzed.
error.clip.state.queued: This file is waiting for its turn.
error.clip.state.imported: This file has not been analyzed yet.
error.clip.state.stopped: The analysis of this file was stopped. Analyze it again.
error.clip.state.failed: The analysis of this file failed. Analyze it again.
error.deep.too_large: This picture needs {tiles} heavy-model passes in deep mode, more than the {limit} allowed. Use careful mode, or crop or shrink the picture.
error.deep.too_much_work: This clip needs about {minutes} minutes of heavy-model work in deep mode, more than the {limit} minutes allowed. Use careful mode, or a shorter clip.
error.demo.deep: Deep detection is not available in demo mode.
error.demo.disabled: This is not available in demo mode.
error.demo.limit: This file is over the limit of demo mode ({limit}, at most {max}).
error.engine.crashed: The engine stopped unexpectedly. Nothing was exported from the file it was working on.
error.engine.silent: The engine did not answer for {minutes} minutes and was stopped.
error.internal: The local server hit an internal error.
error.job.busy: Another job is running. Wait for it to end or stop it.
error.media.damaged: {name} could not be processed to the end: the file is damaged or the new one could not be written. Nothing was saved.
error.model.load: A detection model could not be loaded ({kind}). Fetch the model files with scripts/fetch_models.py into the models folder (or the folder ANONYMIZER_MODELS names), then analyze again.
error.output.check_failed: The written file failed the final check and was discarded.
error.output.exists: {path} already exists. Nothing is ever overwritten.
error.output.name_too_long: The name of the output file would be too long for the file system (the limit is {limit} bytes). Use a shorter name pattern or rename the original.
error.output.disk_full: There is not enough free space in {path}. Free some space or choose another folder.
error.photo.gps_not_removed: The location data could not be removed from the photo, so it was not exported.
error.photo.metadata_not_removed: The camera and descriptive data (maker notes, previews, comments) could not be removed from the photo, so it was not exported.
error.photo.not_enough_memory: Not enough memory for this {megapixels} MP photo: it needs about {needed_mb} MB and {free_mb} MB are free.
error.photo.several_images: This file holds {count} images (an animation or several pages). Only single images are supported.
error.request.forbidden: This request is not allowed. If you opened this page from a bookmark, use the address the Studio printed when it started. If you did use that address, your browser may be blocking cookies for 127.0.0.1: allow them for this address.
error.browse.denied: You do not have permission to open it.
error.source.changed: The original file changed after it was analyzed. Analyze it again.
error.upload.too_large: The file is too large (the limit is {max_mb} MB).
error.video.no_frames: No video frames could be read from this file.
face.reason.low_verify: A second look found something face-like, but not enough to blur it unasked. Please check.
face.reason.second_confirmed: A heavier model confirmed this face on a second look.
face.reason.second_found: Found by a heavier model on a second look at a suspect area.
face.reason.seen_often: Seen in many frames and never contradicted.
face.reason.sweep_only: A strong first detection that the second look did not confirm. Please check.
photo.warning.metadata_dropped: The photo's metadata could not be carried over and was left out.
photo.warning.resaved_for_metadata: The photo was saved again to remove its camera and descriptive data (maker notes, previews, comments).
photo.warning.resaved_trailing_data: The photo had extra data after the image, so it was saved again without it.
photo.warning.trailing_data_removed: Extra data after the image was removed.
plate.reason.off_vehicle: A plate-like shape that is not on a detected vehicle. Please check.
plate.reason.on_vehicle_confirmed: On a vehicle, seen often enough or confirmed by a second look.
plate.reason.on_vehicle_verified: On a vehicle and confirmed by a second look.
plate.reason.unconfirmed: On a vehicle but not confirmed. Please check.
plate.reason.vehicle_text: Text on a vehicle (a plate, a number or other writing). Blurred only if it is placed like a plate. Please check.
plate.reason.position_band: Where a plate usually sits on a small vehicle; no text was found there. Blurred by default.
report.reason.turned_off: You chose to leave it visible.
report.none: Nothing was found in this file.
report.note.comparison_video: A comparison video with the original, not blurred, was written with this output ({file}). It must not be published.
report.note.band: A dash under Certainty marks a plate band: the place where a plate usually sits on a small vehicle, blurred by default although no text was found there, so it has no certainty. In the CSV and JSON files these items carry a constant 1.0 in max_score; it is not a confidence.
report.pdf.no_browser: A PDF report needs a Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge or Chromium), and none was found.
report.pdf.unavailable: The PDF report could not be made.
report.title: Privacy report
video.warning.audio_reencoded: The audio could not be copied as it was and was re-encoded.
video.warning.audio_tracks_lost: Some audio tracks could not be kept.
video.warning.converted_to_8bit: The video was converted to 8-bit standard color.
video.warning.extra_video_tracks: The file has more than one video track. Only the first was anonymized.
video.warning.odd_size_cropped: One pixel was cropped because the video has an odd size.
video.warning.source_truncated: The video seems cut short: the output is shorter than the source says.
warning.analysis.not_saved: The analysis could not be saved to disk. It is kept in memory.
warning.analysis.unchecked: Frames that could not be checked: {frames}. This clip cannot be exported as clean.
warning.comparison.contains_original: The comparison video ({file}) shows the original without any blur. Do not publish it.
warning.comparison.stopped: You stopped the export while the comparison video of {name} was being made: the anonymized file and its reports are written, the comparison video is not.
warning.import.ignored: {count} files were not recognized and were left out ({extensions}).
warning.import.ignored.one: 1 file was not recognized and was left out ({extensions}).
warning.import.hidden: {count} hidden entries (names that start with a dot) were not imported.
warning.import.hidden.one: 1 hidden entry (a name that starts with a dot) was not imported.
warning.import.same_reason: {count} more files were not imported, for the same reason (among them {names}).
warning.review.check_left_visible: {count} items the detectors were not sure about stay visible in the output.
warning.review.check_left_visible.one: 1 item the detectors were not sure about stays visible in the output.
warning.settings.not_saved: Your settings could not be saved to disk. They apply until the Studio stops.
warning.second_look.zones_skipped: The second look checks a limited number of places and left {count} places unchecked. Those places keep the result of the first look, which is quicker but less thorough.
warning.second_look.zones_skipped.one: The second look checks a limited number of places and left 1 place unchecked. That place keeps the result of the first look, which is quicker but less thorough.
warning.vehicles.skipped: Fast looks into a limited number of vehicles for plates: {count} were left out, and a plate on one of them may not have been found. A more thorough level looks into more.
warning.vehicles.skipped.one: Fast looks into a limited number of vehicles for plates: 1 was left out, and a plate on it may not have been found. A more thorough level looks into more.
